[S0] On 27 February 2022 the Council adopted resolution 2623 (2022), 11 in favour and one against (Russia), with three abstentions (China, India and the United Arab Emirates).
[S1] It decided to call a General Assembly emergency special session on Ukraine, recording that permanent-member disagreement at its 8979th meeting had prevented the Council from exercising its primary responsibility.
[S2] Brazil supported the resolution despite reservations regarding its timing and potential contribution to peace.
[S2] Brazil urged adding the General Assembly's voice, citing urgency.
[S2] Brazil qualified its support by noting the Council had not yet exhausted instruments for a negotiated solution.

[S0] On 27 February 2022 the Council adopted resolution 2623 (2022), 11 in favour and one against (Russia), with three abstentions (China, India and the United Arab Emirates).
[S1] It decided to call a General Assembly emergency special session on Ukraine, recording that permanent-member disagreement at its 8979th meeting had prevented the Council from exercising its primary responsibility.
[S3] Russia's representative Nebenzia explained the negative vote by objecting to the draft recording the Council's inability to uphold its primary responsibility.
[S3] Nebenzia distinguished this vote from Russia's earlier veto of draft S/2022/155.
